verdict.rationale: Codex ships a browsable catalog before install. `/plugins` opens a plugin browser in the CLI, and the Plugins tab lets users browse and install in ChatGPT/Codex. One universal plugin directory makes public plugins discoverable across surfaces. Hands-on probes confirmed a public, keyless curated marketplace.json ('Codex official') with categories and install policies, and a real install from that catalog. Missing for 10: no evidence of keyword search or ranking/leaderboard features within the browser, and no independent community corroboration of the browsing experience itself.
